purpose: Methodology pilot before the full 8-fixture real-agent cohort: one parallelizable workload, one tightly coupled shared-interface workload, and one communication-stress workload that directly exercises DM versus room coordination.
promotionChecks: All 24 trial templates validate and retain the same pinned cohort configuration.
No workflow requires ad-hoc prompt edits or fixture reinterpretation after seeing results.
Failed task/model/provider runs are retained rather than silently rerun away.
Independent review can use blindId where the artifact does not reveal workflow structure.
Provider tokens/cost remain null when the host does not report them.
Observed variance and failure modes are reviewed before promoting to the full 96-trial cohort.
notes: This pilot is not powered to establish a general productivity claim.
The noisy-room fixture is included specifically to stress the #33 brain_multi_dm versus brain_multi_room comparison.
Recovery, reviewer-disagreement and worktree-conflict scenarios remain for the full 8-fixture cohort after methodology validation.
